scope_guard.note: If you develop chest pain, call 999
scope_guard.without_guard: Chest pain is coded as a current finding.
scope_guard.with_guard: Chest pain is suppressed. It never reaches the coding review list.
scope_guard.data_change: The entity is deleted from the extract (suppressed).

lab_value_guard.without_guard: The number can be coded as kidney disease.
lab_value_guard.with_guard: This line is treated as a lab result, not a diagnosis.
lab_value_guard.data_change: A lab name plus a number stays a measurement.

referral_routing_guard.without_guard: A bare 'referral submitted' line is treated as form wording and dropped.
referral_routing_guard.with_guard: This line is kept because it names FIT, a real test.
referral_routing_guard.data_change: Informational referral wording is removed. Named tests and cancer sites stay.

assertion_guard.without_guard: A nearby 'not' can mark ex-smoker as absent.
assertion_guard.with_guard: Ex-smoker is restored to present. The status is already in the words.
assertion_guard.data_change: Assertion is set back to present for this lifestyle code.

entity_type_norm.without_guard: New episode can be coded as a disease.
entity_type_norm.with_guard: It is relabelled as a qualifier. It is not a condition.
entity_type_norm.data_change: Entity type changes from a temporal or finding label to qualifier_value.

checkbox_norm.note: Has the patient been seen before? [X]
checkbox_norm.without_guard: The form question can be extracted as a clinical finding.
checkbox_norm.with_guard: The admin question is marked so it is not extracted.
checkbox_norm.data_change: Admin form prompts are marked non-extractable.

situation_lookup.without_guard: Search uses the local wording and can miss the usual code.
situation_lookup.with_guard: The phrase is rewritten to fast track referral.
situation_lookup.data_change: Surface text is replaced with a standard lookup term. No diagnosis is added.

term_concept_blocklist.without_guard: FIT can auto-code as a seizure (91175000).
term_concept_blocklist.with_guard: That seizure code is blocked. A reviewer can still pick the stool test.
term_concept_blocklist.data_change: The listed clinical code is suppressed for this wording. The mention is not deleted.

body_structure_guard.without_guard: Arm is dropped before linking, so numbness has no site.
body_structure_guard.with_guard: Arm is kept as a site so it can link to numbness.
body_structure_guard.data_change: The body-structure span stays in the extract for relation linking.

fact_link_guard.without_guard: The allergy and the drug stay as two unlinked facts.
fact_link_guard.with_guard: Caused-by is an allowed link type. The reaction can point at the drug.

scope_guard:safety_netting.note: If you develop chest pain, call 999
scope_guard:safety_netting.without_guard: Chest pain is coded as a current finding.
scope_guard:safety_netting.with_guard: Chest pain is suppressed. It never reaches the coding review list.
scope_guard:safety_netting.data_change: The entity is deleted from the extract (suppressed).

scope_guard:recommendation.without_guard: Metformin is coded as a current drug.
scope_guard:recommendation.with_guard: Metformin is kept but marked hypothetical. A reviewer decides.
scope_guard:recommendation.data_change: Assertion changes from present to hypothetical. The entity is not deleted.

entity_type_norm:severity_modifier.without_guard: Severe can be coded as a disease.
entity_type_norm:severity_modifier.with_guard: It is relabelled as a qualifier of another finding.
entity_type_norm:severity_modifier.data_change: Entity type changes from finding to qualifier_value.

referral_routing_guard:named_test.without_guard: A bare referral-submitted line is dropped as form wording.
referral_routing_guard:named_test.with_guard: This line is kept because it names MRI, a real test.
referral_routing_guard:named_test.data_change: Spans that name a test stay in the extract.

referral_routing_guard:site.without_guard: Pathway labels can drown out the cancer site.
referral_routing_guard:site.data_change: Site-named suspected-cancer wording stays in the extract.

body_structure_guard:always_keep.without_guard: A standalone cervix mention can be dropped.
body_structure_guard:always_keep.with_guard: Cervix is always kept for the gender check.
body_structure_guard:always_keep.data_change: The reproductive-organ span stays even with no finding.

body_structure_guard:keep_as_site.with_guard: Arm is kept so numbness can link to it.
body_structure_guard:keep_as_site.data_change: The site span stays for finding_site linking.

body_structure_guard:drop_orphan.without_guard: Unknown anatomy can be coded as a standalone fact.
body_structure_guard:drop_orphan.with_guard: A body part that matches no keep rule is dropped.
body_structure_guard:drop_orphan.data_change: The span is suppressed in post-processing.

fact_link_guard:allowed_relation.without_guard: Any pair of nearby terms can be stored as a link.
fact_link_guard:allowed_relation.with_guard: Only configured types such as finding_site are applied.
fact_link_guard:allowed_relation.data_change: Runtime allowlist includes finding_site and excludes associated_finding.

referral_routing_guard:keep_action.without_guard: Any line with referral can be dropped as form wording.
referral_routing_guard:keep_action.with_guard: Declined referral is kept. It is a clinical action.
referral_routing_guard:keep_action.data_change: Keep-action phrases stay in the extract.

tcb-001.without_guard: A generic mention can auto-code to a specific named operation (1287097003).
tcb-001.data_change: Auto-coding of this wording to 1287097003 is suppressed.

tcb-002.without_guard: This phrasing can auto-code to malaise (367391008).
tcb-002.data_change: Auto-coding of this wording to 367391008 is suppressed.

tcb-003.without_guard: Advice wording can auto-code to malignant neoplasm of nervous system (372063002).
tcb-003.data_change: Auto-coding of this wording to 372063002 is suppressed.

tcb-004.without_guard: FIT can auto-code as a seizure (91175000).
tcb-004.data_change: Auto-coding of this wording to 91175000 is suppressed.

sl-001.without_guard: Search looks for 2ww referral and can miss the usual code.
sl-001.data_change: Surface text is replaced with fast track referral.

sl-007.without_guard: The phrase might be rewritten when it should be left alone.
sl-007.with_guard: Left as awaiting results. No rewrite.
sl-007.data_change: No canonical term. The extract wording is unchanged.
